- [Core Nodes Overview](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/core-nodes/overview.md): Built-in workflow nodes that don't require a third-party integration
- [AI Extract](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/core-nodes/ai-extract.md): Extract structured data from unstructured text using AI
- [AI Classify](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/core-nodes/ai-classify.md): Classify text into predefined categories using AI
- [AI Generate](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/core-nodes/ai-generate.md): Generate text content using AI
- [Custom Code](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/core-nodes/custom-code.md): Run Python code within your workflow
- [Webhook](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/core-nodes/webhook.md): Send and receive HTTP requests in workflows
- [Schedule](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/core-nodes/schedule.md): Add delays and timing control to workflows
- [File Operations](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/core-nodes/file-operations.md): Upload, parse, search, and extract text from files in workflows
- [Conditionals](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/core-nodes/conditionals.md): Add branching logic to your workflows
- [Loops](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/core-nodes/loops.md): Iterate over collections or repeat actions a fixed number of times
- [Module Change](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/core-nodes/module-change.md): Jump to a different module within a workflow
- [Call Workflow](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/core-nodes/call-workflow.md): Invoke another workflow and wait for its response, or start it and continue

- [Transfer popup](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/voice-agents/transfer-node-popup.md): Send a context popup to human agents when transferring a call

- [Twin Overview](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/twin/overview.md): A managed PostgreSQL database for your organization, built into the platform
- [Managing Tables](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/twin/managing-tables.md): Create tables, columns, foreign keys, and views in your Twin database
- [Polling Tables](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/twin/polling-tables.md): Keep a Twin table automatically synced from an external HTTP endpoint
- [Workflow Run Dumps](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/twin/workflow-run-dumps.md): Automatically persist workflow run outputs into a Twin table

- [Using Twin in Apps](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/twin/using-in-apps.md): Consume Twin data from a HappyRobot App, and version your schema safely alongside App deploys

- [Annotations](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/runs/annotations.md): Add annotations and notes to runs

- [Creating experiments](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/experiments/creating-experiments.md): Set up an A/B test with variants, traffic split, and metrics
- [Experiment metrics](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/experiments/experiment-metrics.md): Default and custom metrics available for measuring experiment outcomes
- [Analyzing results](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/experiments/analyzing-results.md): Read your experiment dashboard and make data-driven decisions
- [A/B testing guide](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/experiments/ab-testing-guide.md): A practical guide to running reliable experiments, from core statistics to decision-making patterns
- [Quality and evaluation overview](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/evaluate/overview.md): Define quality standards, automatically audit runs, and continuously improve agent behavior
- [Northstars](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/evaluate/northstars.md): Define behavioral quality criteria for your agents
- [Automated audits](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/evaluate/audits.md): Every run is automatically evaluated against your northstars
- [Audio audits](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/evaluate/audio-audits.md): Analyze transcription accuracy, conversation quality, and acoustic metrics for voice agent calls
- [Issues](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/evaluate/issues.md): Track and resolve quality problems surfaced by audits and flags
- [Custom tests](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/evaluate/custom-tests.md): Create test cases with expected conversation flows and tool calls
- [Adversarial tests](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/evaluate/adversarial-tests.md): Simulate a user challenging an agent across a full conversation and grade the result against northstars
- [Test suites](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/evaluate/test-suites.md): Group prompt and adversarial tests into suites and run them together against a workflow version
- [Analytics Overview](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/analytics/overview.md): Track performance and gain insights
- [KPI Dashboard](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/analytics/kpi-dashboard.md): Monitor key performance indicators
- [Workflow Metrics](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/analytics/workflow-metrics.md): Analyze workflow-level performance data

- [HappyRobot Email](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/integrations/communication/happyrobot-email.md): Use HappyRobot's built-in email service

- [Google Sheets](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/integrations/data/google-sheets.md): Read and write data to Google Sheets

- [Scope Tags](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/settings/scope-tags.md): Organize resources and limit roles to matching tagged resources
- [SSO Access](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/settings/sso-access.md): Configure SSO login and resolve identity-provider groups into access grants

- [Bring your own keys](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/settings/bring-your-own-keys.md): Run HappyRobot AI features on your organization's own OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini credentials
- [Environment Variables](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/settings/environment-variables.md): Configure environment variables for your workflows
- [Usage and Billing](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/settings/billing.md): Monitor your organization's usage and credit consumption
- [Workflow Settings](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/settings/workflow-settings.md): Configure settings for individual workflows
- [SLA and service status](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/settings/sla.md): Review measured platform availability, live incidents, and how uptime is calculated
- [EU AI Act and GDPR requirements](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/compliance/eu-ai-act-and-gdpr.md): Disclosure and recording requirements for agents that interact with people in the EU

- [Frontal MCP](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/developer-tools/mcp-frontal.md): Build and edit workflows through conversation from your own MCP client

- [TypeScript SDK](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/developer-tools/sdk/overview.md): Install and configure the HappyRobot TypeScript SDK to manage workflows, voice agents, and integrations programmatically
- [Quickstart](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/developer-tools/sdk/quickstart.md): Trigger a workflow run and read the results in under five minutes
- [Voice agent tutorial](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/developer-tools/sdk/voice-agent-tutorial.md): Create a voice agent, trigger an outbound call, and stream live messages with the TypeScript SDK

- [Chatbot tutorial](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/developer-tools/sdk/chatbot-tutorial.md): Build a custom chat UI with the TypeScript SDK using React and Express
- [Workflows](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/developer-tools/sdk/workflows.md): Manage workflows, versions, nodes, runs, and folders with the TypeScript SDK
- [Sessions and messages](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/developer-tools/sdk/sessions-and-messages.md): Read session details, fetch messages, and stream live conversation events with the TypeScript SDK
- [Telephony](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/developer-tools/sdk/telephony.md): Manage phone numbers and SIP trunks with the TypeScript SDK
- [Integrations](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/developer-tools/sdk/integrations.md): Discover integrations and access Google Sheets, Slack, Teams, Twilio SMS, and WhatsApp sub-resources
- [Resources](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/developer-tools/sdk/resources.md): Manage contacts, knowledge bases, variables, MCP servers, apps, billing, voices, and API keys
- [Quality and testing](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/developer-tools/sdk/quality.md): Run test suites and adversarial tests, manage northstar criteria, custom evals, issues, and audit remarks
- [Helpers](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/developer-tools/sdk/helpers.md): Use pagination patterns and high-level helper utilities in the TypeScript SDK
- [Error handling](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/developer-tools/sdk/error-handling.md): Handle errors and configure retry behavior in the TypeScript SDK
- [Describe the current API key](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/api-keys/describe-the-current-api-key.md): Returns metadata for the API key used in the Authorization header.
- [[Legacy] List runs](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/runs/[legacy]-list-runs.md): Lists runs for a use case. **Deprecated**: prefer GET /workflows/:workflow_id/runs instead.
- [Cancel a run](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/runs/cancel-a-run.md): Cancels a running or scheduled run for the caller's org by proxying to the workflows service.
- [Get recordings for a run](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/runs/get-recordings-for-a-run.md): Returns signed URLs for call recordings associated with a run. Optionally filter by session_id.
- [List run sessions](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/runs/list-run-sessions.md): Returns paginated sessions for a run, ordered by timestamp.
- [Get run](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/runs/get-run.md): Returns metadata for a single run. Use /runs/:run_id/nodes for node summaries, /runs/:run_id/outputs/:output_id for a full node output payload, /runs/:run_id/sessions for session data, and /runs/:run_id/flags for issues.
- [List run nodes](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/runs/list-run-nodes.md): Returns lightweight run node execution records in timestamp order.
- [Get run output](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/runs/get-run-output.md): Returns the full payload for a single output execution in a run.
- [Mark run annotation](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/runs/mark-run-annotation.md): Marks a run as correct, incorrect, or critical. When marked as incorrect or critical with a correction message, an issue is automatically created.
- [List run flags](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/runs/list-run-flags.md): Returns paginated flags (issues) for a run, ordered by creation date.
- [List audit remarks for a run](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/runs/list-audit-remarks-for-a-run.md): Returns all northstar audit remarks for a specific run, showing per-criterion pass/fail grades.
- [Get usage totals](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/billing/get-usage-totals.md): Returns the authenticated organization's total voice minutes, emails, and text messages between the inclusive start and end datetimes. Use Get usage details for the same usage grouped by workflow.
- [Get usage details](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/billing/get-usage-details.md): Returns the authenticated organization's voice minutes, emails, and text messages grouped by workflow between the inclusive start and end datetimes. Filter by one or more workflow IDs using repeated use_case_id parameters or a comma-separated list; omit the filter to include all workflows.
- [Get credits](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/billing/get-credits.md): Returns the authenticated organization's billable credit consumption by workflow for an inclusive date range, grouped daily, weekly, or monthly. Each row includes the period, full folder path, workflow identity, total credits, and the same L1 → L2 → L3 component breakdown shown in Settings → Usage,…
- [Get run credits](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/billing/get-run-credits.md): Returns credit consumption for a single run, broken down with the same L1 -> L2 -> L3 component taxonomy as Get credits (category -> subcomponents). Scoped to the authenticated organization via API key.
- [[Legacy] List use cases](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/use-cases/[legacy]-list-use-cases.md): Returns use cases for the authenticated org along with the live production version if available (or the most recent version as fallback). **Deprecated**: prefer GET /workflows instead.
- [Lookup contact by identifier](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/contacts/lookup-contact-by-identifier.md): Returns contact if found by type and value. Returns 404 if not found. Does not create new contacts.
- [List contacts](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/contacts/list-contacts.md): Returns paginated contacts for the organization. Uses cursor-based pagination.
- [Get contact](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/contacts/get-contact.md): Returns a single contact with interaction and memory counts
- [List contact interactions](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/contacts/list-contact-interactions.md): Returns paginated communication events for a contact
- [List contact memories](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/contacts/list-contact-memories.md): Returns paginated memories for a contact
- [Get knowledge bases](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/knowledge-bases/get-knowledge-bases.md): List all knowledge bases for the organization.
- [Post knowledge bases](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/knowledge-bases/post-knowledge-bases.md): Create a new knowledge base for the organization.
- [Get knowledge bases files](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/knowledge-bases/get-knowledge-bases-files.md): List all files in a knowledge base. Use this endpoint to check file processing status after triggering chunking via POST /:kbId/trigger-chunking.
- [Post knowledge bases upload urls](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/knowledge-bases/post-knowledge-bases-upload-urls.md): Step 1 of the file upload flow. Creates file records in the database and returns presigned object-storage URLs (valid for 3 minutes). Upload each file using uploadUrl and send uploadHeaders when present, then call POST /:kbId/trigger-chunking with the returned fileIds to start processing.
- [Post knowledge bases trigger chunking](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/knowledge-bases/post-knowledge-bases-trigger-chunking.md): Step 2 of the file upload flow. Call this endpoint after uploading files to object storage using the presigned URLs and any uploadHeaders from POST /:kbId/upload-urls. Triggers embedding generation for the specified files. Files will be available in the knowledge base within 10-15 minutes. Use GET /…
- [Delete knowledge bases](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/knowledge-bases/delete-knowledge-bases.md): Delete a knowledge base and all associated files and chunks. This action is irreversible.
- [Delete knowledge bases files](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/knowledge-bases/delete-knowledge-bases-files.md): Delete a file from a knowledge base. This removes the file from storage and deletes all associated chunks. This action is irreversible.
- [List workflows](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/workflows/list-workflows.md): Returns paginated workflows for the authenticated organization. Each workflow includes its latest version info (live production version preferred, otherwise most recent). Supports searching by name and filtering by folder.
- [Create a workflow](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/workflows/create-a-workflow.md): Creates a new workflow in the authenticated organization. Supports three creation modes:
- [Get a workflow](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/workflows/get-a-workflow.md): Returns a single workflow by UUID or slug, including its latest version info (live production version preferred, otherwise most recent).
- [Delete a workflow](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/workflows/delete-a-workflow.md): Soft-deletes a workflow by UUID or slug. The workflow must not have any live versions — unpublish all versions before deleting.
- [Update a workflow](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/workflows/update-a-workflow.md): Updates workflow metadata and settings. Accepts a workflow UUID or slug as the path parameter. Set `folder_id` to `null` to move the workflow to the root level. Use `settings` to update configuration such as webhooks, out-of-office hours, approval process, data retention, and audits. This endpoint d…
- [List workflow versions](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/workflows/list-workflow-versions.md): Returns paginated versions for a workflow. Supports searching by version number or version name.
- [List workflow templates](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/workflows/list-workflow-templates.md): Returns a paginated list of available workflow templates. Each template includes a description and the inputs it accepts (marked as required or optional). Use a template's name in the `from_template.template` field when creating a workflow.
- [Duplicate a workflow](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/workflows/duplicate-a-workflow.md): Creates a copy of a workflow including all its nodes and configurations. The duplicated workflow is created as a new unpublished workflow with version number 1. If the source uses workflow engine v2, the duplicate remains an editable v2 draft and cannot be published through the public API until upgr…
- [Publish a workflow](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/workflows/publish-a-workflow.md): Publishes the latest version of the specified workflow to make it live. Before publishing, all action nodes are checked for test errors and untested status. If untested nodes exist (with no errors), a synchronous test-all is triggered first. If any node has test errors, the publish is blocked and er…
- [Unpublish a workflow](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/workflows/unpublish-a-workflow.md): Finds the currently live version for the workflow and unpublishes it. The version is taken offline and unlocked for editing. Returns 400 if no version is currently live. Accepts a workflow UUID or slug as the path parameter.
- [List workflow runs](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/workflows/list-workflow-runs.md): Returns paginated runs for a workflow. Supports filtering by status, date ranges, and annotation.
- [Trigger a workflow run](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/workflows/trigger-a-workflow-run.md): Starts a new run for a workflow by proxying to the hooks service. Accepts either a JSON body with payload/environment fields, or a multipart/form-data request with a file and optional form fields (pass environment as a query param for multipart). Supports targeting different environments (production…
- [List workflow sessions](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/workflows/list-workflow-sessions.md): Returns paginated sessions for a workflow across all runs, ordered by timestamp.
- [Cancel active workflow runs](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/workflows/cancel-active-workflow-runs.md): Cancels all current and queued runs for the workflow. By default, the currently live workflow version is also unpublished. Set unpublish_workflow to false to keep the workflow published after cancellation. Accepts a workflow UUID or slug as the path parameter.
- [List workflow variables](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/workflow-variables/list-workflow-variables.md): Returns paginated variables scoped to a specific workflow. Accepts a workflow UUID or slug as the path parameter.
- [Create a workflow variable](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/workflow-variables/create-a-workflow-variable.md): Creates a new variable scoped to the specified workflow. Accepts a workflow UUID or slug as the path parameter.
- [Delete a workflow variable](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/workflow-variables/delete-a-workflow-variable.md): Permanently deletes a variable from a workflow. This action cannot be undone.
- [Update a workflow variable](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/workflow-variables/update-a-workflow-variable.md): Updates one or more fields on a variable. Only the fields provided in the request body are updated.
- [List northstar audits for a workflow](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/audits/list-northstar-audits-for-a-workflow.md): Returns paginated northstar audit results for a workflow, showing pass/fail rates per behavioral criterion.
- [List audit remarks for a northstar](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/audits/list-audit-remarks-for-a-northstar.md): Returns cursor-paginated audit remarks for a specific northstar criterion, optionally filtered by grade.
- [List audit remarks for a workflow](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/audits/list-audit-remarks-for-a-workflow.md): Returns cursor-paginated behavioral audit remarks across all northstar criteria for a workflow. Optionally filter by northstar, grade, or status.
- [List node errors for a workflow](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/audits/list-node-errors-for-a-workflow.md): Returns paginated node execution errors for a workflow, grouped by node and error type.
- [Get audit stats for the live workflow version](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/audits/get-audit-stats-for-the-live-workflow-version.md): Returns aggregate audit statistics for the live (or most recently audited) version of a workflow.
- [List audited versions for a workflow](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/audits/list-audited-versions-for-a-workflow.md): Returns all versions of a workflow that have audit data, indicating which is the live version.
- [Get an audit remark by ID](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/audits/get-an-audit-remark-by-id.md): Returns a single behavioral audit remark, including its northstar criterion, grade, correction, evaluated messages, and status.
- [Get feedback for an audit remark](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/audits/get-feedback-for-an-audit-remark.md): Returns the current caller's feedback for an audit remark, or null if none exists. Supports user-level and org-level API keys.
- [Submit feedback for an audit remark](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/audits/submit-feedback-for-an-audit-remark.md): Submit a thumbs up/down for an audit remark. Supports user-level and org-level API keys. A thumbs-up automatically adds the remark as a northstar example.
- [Delete feedback for an audit remark](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/audits/delete-feedback-for-an-audit-remark.md): Removes the current caller's feedback for an audit remark. Supports user-level and org-level API keys.
- [List issues for a workflow](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/issues/list-issues-for-a-workflow.md): Returns paginated quality issues (flags) for a workflow, optionally filtered by status or source.

- [Lock a version](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/versions/lock-a-version.md): Locks the specified version, preventing further edits to its nodes. Accepts a version UUID or slug as the path parameter.
- [Unlock a version](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/versions/unlock-a-version.md): Unlocks the specified version, allowing edits to its nodes. A version that is currently live cannot be unlocked — use unpublish instead. Accepts a version UUID or slug as the path parameter.
- [Unpublish a version](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/versions/unpublish-a-version.md): Unpublishes the version (takes it offline) and unlocks it for editing. The version will no longer be live and its published lock is removed, allowing further modifications. The version must currently be live. Accepts a version UUID or slug as the path parameter.
- [List version nodes](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/versions/list-version-nodes.md): Returns all workflow nodes belonging to the specified version. The version can be identified by its UUID or slug.

For webhook trigger nodes (INCOMING_HOOK or PREDEFINED_REQUEST), the response also includes production, staging, development, and test webhook URLs.

For tool, condition, and paths-root nodes, owned child nodes are also cascade-deleted. Only works for action nodes (nodes with an event_id).

This upserts the node's generated output schema, marking the node as complete. - [Test a single node](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/versions/test-a-single-node.md): Triggers a test run for a single node in the specified version. The node must have a complete configuration and the version must not be published. Returns the generated node output (schema) on success.
- [Test all nodes in a version](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/versions/test-all-nodes-in-a-version.md): Triggers a synchronous test-all run for every testable node in the specified version. Nodes are executed in dependency waves — independent nodes run in parallel. If a node fails, dependent nodes are skipped. The endpoint blocks until all nodes have been tested and returns per-node results.
- [Inspect a tool's Tool Call Result](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/versions/inspect-a-tools-tool-call-result.md): Returns the current Tool Call Result and acks the tool.

- [Generate a tool's Tool Call Result](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/versions/generate-a-tools-tool-call-result.md): Generates every testable node.
- [Set Tool Call Result visibility](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/versions/set-tool-call-result-visibility.md): Replaces the complete list of generated leaf fields one branch node exposes to the agent.
- [List prompt issues](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/versions/list-prompt-issues.md): Returns prompt quality issues for all prompt nodes in the specified version. Issues are generated asynchronously by the platform's prompt analysis system. Each prompt node includes its current prompt text, issue generation status, and any open (non-rejected) issues with recommendations.

Workflows inside the folder are moved to the folder specified by `move_to`, or to the parent folder if `move_to` is omitted. Sub-folders are also moved to the same destination.

- [Create a shared Tests folder in a prompt node’s workflow](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/custom-evals/create-a-shared-tests-folder-in-a-prompt-node’s-workflow.md): Create a workflow-wide Tests folder. The node resolves the workflow; folder placement is independent of prompt or agent ownership. File top-level tests and suites via folder_id on update.
- [Get a custom eval by ID](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/custom-evals/get-a-custom-eval-by-id.md)
- [Delete a custom eval](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/custom-evals/delete-a-custom-eval.md)
- [Update a custom eval](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/custom-evals/update-a-custom-eval.md)
- [Run a custom eval](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/custom-evals/run-a-custom-eval.md): Execute the eval asynchronously. Poll /custom-evals/:eval_id/runs for results.
- [List custom eval runs](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/custom-evals/list-custom-eval-runs.md)
- [List adversarial tests for a node](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/adversarial-tests/list-adversarial-tests-for-a-node.md)
- [Get an adversarial test by ID](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/adversarial-tests/get-an-adversarial-test-by-id.md)
- [List adversarial test runs](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/adversarial-tests/list-adversarial-test-runs.md)
- [Get adversarial test run by ID](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/adversarial-tests/get-adversarial-test-run-by-id.md): Full status and audit remarks for a single test run.
- [Get adversarial test run messages](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/adversarial-tests/get-adversarial-test-run-messages.md): The full conversation that took place during this adversarial test run.
- [Get the resolved audit scope for an adversarial test](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/adversarial-tests/get-the-resolved-audit-scope-for-an-adversarial-test.md): Returns the northstar categories that BEA will grade against when this test runs. Generated tests inherit the suite's scope; standalone tests carry their own. Use this to display 'currently grading against tags: [...]' without re-implementing the resolution.
- [List adversarial suites for a node](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/adversarial-suites/list-adversarial-suites-for-a-node.md)
- [Get an adversarial suite by ID](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/adversarial-suites/get-an-adversarial-suite-by-id.md): Returns the suite and the mermaid workflow graph if already generated.
- [List adversarial suite runs](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/adversarial-suites/list-adversarial-suite-runs.md)
- [Get adversarial suite run by ID](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/adversarial-suites/get-adversarial-suite-run-by-id.md): Full status and aggregate counts for a suite run.
- [List test runs in a suite run](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/adversarial-suites/list-test-runs-in-a-suite-run.md): All individual adversarial test results within this suite run.

Use this to inspect what an event expects before creating a node.

Unlike POST /twin/tables (a bare table), the server resolves the workflow's variable catalog and binds each column to a variable, so completed runs populate the table automatically. Captures every variable by def…
- [Delete a Twin workflow dump](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/twin/delete-a-twin-workflow-dump.md): Deletes the workflow dump run-capture config for a table. Set dropTable=true to also drop the physical table and all its data.
- [Create a chat client token](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/chat/create-a-chat-client-token.md): Generates a scoped JWT for browser-side chat operations. Call this from your backend with your API key, then pass the token to the frontend.
- [Create a chat session](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/chat/create-a-chat-session.md): Creates a new chat session for the workflow scoped in the client token.
- [Send a chat message](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/chat/send-a-chat-message.md): Sends a user message to the chat session. The AI response will arrive via WebSocket.
- [Close a chat session](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/chat/close-a-chat-session.md): Ends the chat session, stopping the AI agent. The session cannot be resumed after this call.
- [Get chat session history](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/chat/get-chat-session-history.md): Retrieves message history for a chat session. Useful for page reloads or reconnects.
- [Get presigned upload URL](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/chat/get-presigned-upload-url.md): Returns a presigned S3 URL for direct file upload from the browser. After uploading, call POST /chat/upload/complete to register the artifact.
- [Complete file upload](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/chat/complete-file-upload.md): Registers an uploaded artifact after direct S3 upload. Call this after uploading the file to the presigned URL.
- [Create a realtime client token](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/realtime/create-a-realtime-client-token.md): Generates a scoped JWT for browser-side realtime connections.
- [Create artifact download URLs](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/artifacts/create-artifact-download-urls.md): Returns fresh presigned URLs after verifying each artifact against its server-authored message and the caller's workflow permissions.
- [[Deprecated] Resolve artifact download URLs](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/artifacts/[deprecated]-resolve-artifact-download-urls.md): This endpoint is deprecated and is scheduled to stop working on October 15, 2026 at 12:00 UTC. Migrate to POST /artifacts/download-urls and provide each artifact's message_id.
- [List available voices](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/voice/list-available-voices.md): Returns the voice catalog available to the authenticated workspace in this HappyRobot cluster. Use the returned id in workflow agent.voices configuration.
- [Create a voice call token](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/voice/create-a-voice-call-token.md): Generates a LiveKit token for browser-side voice calls with AI agents. Call this from your backend with your API key, then pass the token to the frontend. Use workflow_id to start a new call, or session_id to silently listen to an in-progress call. Set should_takeover to true to take over the call i…
- [List signal keys for the org](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/signals/list-signal-keys-for-the-org.md): Returns all configured custom signal keys for nodes in the API key org.
- [Add a custom signal key to node](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/signals/add-a-custom-signal-key-to-node.md): Appends a custom signal key to the target node configuration in all environments.
- [Delete a custom signal key from node](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/signals/delete-a-custom-signal-key-from-node.md): Removes a custom signal key from the target node configuration in all environments.
- [Publish an immediate signal](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/signals/publish-an-immediate-signal.md): Publishes a signal to internal signal service. payload.org_id is always derived from API key org. Built-in keys (org., usecase., session.) are allowed for targeting active sessions.
- [Schedule a delayed signal](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/signals/schedule-a-delayed-signal.md): Schedules a delayed signal in internal signal service. payload.org_id is always derived from API key org.
- [Delete a scheduled signal](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/signals/delete-a-scheduled-signal.md): Cancels a scheduled signal.
- [Patch a scheduled signal](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/api-reference/signals/patch-a-scheduled-signal.md): Updates a scheduled signal. When payload is provided, payload.org_id is always derived from API key org.
- [Carrier Event](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/bridge-api-reference/our-api/ingest-carrier.md): Create or update a carrier in the system
- [Load Event](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/bridge-api-reference/our-api/ingest-load.md): Create one or more loads in the system. This endpoint accepts either a single load object or an array of load objects. The response will match the input format - if you send a single object, you'll receive a single object; if you send an array, you'll receive an array.
- [Get Carrier](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/bridge-api-reference/your-api/find-carrier.md): Get details for a specific carrier
- [Get Load](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/bridge-api-reference/your-api/find-load.md): Get details for a specific load
- [Get Loads](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/bridge-api-reference/your-api/find-loads.md): Search for loads matching the given criteria
- [Log Offer](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/bridge-api-reference/your-api/log-offer.md): Record a carrier's offer for a specific load
- [Release notes](https://docs.happyrobot.ai/release-notes.md)
